```yaml
name: Skill Check & Token Metrics

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --no-restore

      - name: Test
        run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

  collect-metrics:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Run Skill Validator (Collects Token Metrics)
        # Assuming skill-validator is a dotnet tool or project in the repo
        # This step simulates the execution that MetricsCollector captures data from
        run: |
          dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator -- --output-dir ./artifacts/metrics
        env:
          # Ensure token tracking is enabled
          ENABLE_TOKEN_TRACKING: true

      - name: Upload Raw Metrics Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: raw-metrics
          path: ./artifacts/metrics
          retention-days: 5

  generate-dashboard-data:
    needs: collect-metrics
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Raw Metrics
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: raw-metrics
          path: ./artifacts/metrics

      - name: Generate Token Usage Data
        # Aggregates token metrics from eval workflow artifacts into data/token-usage.json
        run: |
          pwsh -File scripts/generate-token-data.ps1 -InputPath ./artifacts/metrics -OutputPath ./data/token-usage.json

      - name: Generate Benchmark Data
        # Extended to include token fields in benchmark output
        run: |
          pwsh -File scripts/generate-benchmark-data.ps1 -InputPath ./artifacts/metrics -OutputPath ./data/benchmark-data.json

      - name: Upload Dashboard Data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: ./data/
          retention-days: 30

  deploy-dashboard:
    needs: generate-dashboard-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Dashboard Data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: ./docs/data

      - name: Prepare Dashboard Assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/assets
          # Copy visualization scripts if they exist in the repo
          if [ -f "src/Dashboard/token-usage.js" ]; then cp src/Dashboard/token-usage.js docs/assets/; fi
          if [ -f "src/Dashboard/dashboard.js" ]; then cp src/Dashboard/dashboard.js docs/assets/; fi
          if [ -f "src/Dashboard/dashboard.html" ]; then cp src/Dashboard/dashboard.html docs/index.html; fi

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: './docs'

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
